label: Andrew the Apostle (S. ANDREAE, APOSTOLI, Die 30 novembris)

chants.notes: IN. and GR. citations share one merged text block on p625 (y 367.9-390.6); band is identical to the GR row and cannot be subdivided without emptying compute_bbox's selection.
Graduale citation (gregobase 351), not the offertorium 'In omnem terram' on p435 (9185). Shares its merged text block with the IN. row above.
Mode I engraved Alleluia; verse 'Dilexit Andream Dominus in odorem suavitatis' begins at the foot of p625 and continues onto the top of p626 (y~13-190 there). Band crops only the p625 portion.
Printed stub 'Mihi autem' resolves against the target-page index form 'Mihi autem nimis' (gregobase 499); p435 also holds a different offertorium 'In omnem terram' (9185, mode 2) not cited here.
Bare em-dash alternate communio printed directly under 'Venite post me, 267.' — a second, real option (chant_group 1021, distinct from 552), not a run-on of the preceding line.
